source.instrument: BioTOF detector -> JA4220 -> ZFL-1000LN+ -> bias tee -> FMC121 (ADS54J60), 1 GS/s, 16 bit; run CopperPulsed_0001, 7 Sep 2022
source.static_figures: appendix9 'Correlated arrivals' (numbers only; no static figure of this set)

caveats: Measured, through the instrument's own capture chain. The run is named CopperPulsed_0001, but the arrivals are uniform across the modulation period: the gate never modulated the beam and no copper peak is present. These are unmodulated ion arrivals with no mass information.

Heights are in units of the local baseline standard deviation (sigma), not volts: the FMC121's volts per code was not recorded. The selection keeps isolated events only (10 sigma, quiet for 8 samples before), so the closest pile-ups are excluded.

Bursts are three or more events inside 5 us gaps: 161 against a chance expectation of about nineteen. Appendix 9 reads the leaders' large heights and the followers' ordinary shapes as ion-feedback afterpulsing in the MCP; that is an interpretation of these data, not a separate measurement.

Shape modes and the anomaly score come from a principal-component fit to these same windows. They rank how unusual a shape is within this run; they are not physical quantities and their sign is arbitrary.
